[[Banshee]]s can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]] at level 15 [[Slayer]] and level 20 [[Combat level|combat]] by various [[Slayer masters]]. They are found in the [[Slayer Tower]] and the [[Catacombs of Kourend]]. Players '''must''' wear [[earmuffs]] or a [[Slayer helm]] when fighting banshees. Lower levelled players who do not have access to a Slayer helm can wear a [[salve amulet]]. Note that the bonuses from the salve amulet do not stack with those from the Slayer helmet.

Banshees are primarily known for their common drops of [[pure essence]], which is helpful for ironmen for [[runecrafting]].

A stronger variant of banshee, the [[Twisted Banshee]], can be found in the Catacombs of Kourend. These are often killed over normal banshees as they are still easy to kill (notably being safespottable) and have much better drops; battlestaves, rune equipment, and larger quantities of herbs.
